# IGILIM Discord Bot

<p class="igilim-project__type">Community management and automation tool</p>

## Overview

The IGILIM Discord Bot is a Python tool developed to automate tasks related to the association’s Discord server. The project responds to community-management, moderation, and event-organization needs.

## Technologies

<p class="igilim-project__technologies"><span>Core technologies&nbsp;:</span> Python · Discord API · Git</p>

## Context and need

::: {.igilim-context}

The project is designed for the IGILIM Discord server and is part of the association’s day-to-day needs. This page remains focused on the software tool rather than on presenting the association itself.

:::

## My work

My work covers the tool’s design, its Python development, and the project’s structure. It also includes reflection on moderation, community-management, and Discord-task automation needs.

## Automation scope

The areas below describe the project’s public scope. They do not detail individual commands or the deployment status of each automation.

::: {.igilim-automation-list}

### Server management

Automation of recurring tasks related to managing the association’s Discord server.

### Moderation

Consideration of moderation needs in the design of the bot’s automations.

### Event organization

Automations intended to support the community’s event organization.

:::

## Project status

<p class="igilim-project__status">This page presents the project’s public aspects at a deliberately high level, without exposing its source code or implementation details.</p>
